title: Strange answers to the psychopath test | Jon Ronson | TED
summary: Jon Ronson, author of The Psychopath Test, gives a TED talk on the blurry line between sane and crazy and on psychopathy as a spectrum, with stories of how the label gets applied.
why: Praised as one of the great non-technical talks, appearing in best-talk lists.

quote.text: In my opinion it is one of the greatest talks of all time and it gave me goosebumps.
